excluded_ambiguous_regions.reason: Small bright service-craft/infrastructure cluster at inner quay: individual hulls and multiplicity unresolved at 10m.
Tiny bright inner-basin signal without a separable hull; remains unknown.
Red along-quay strip may mix cranes/quay and vessel; cannot independently separate a hull from infrastructure in current RGB/B08.
Southern small pier white strip cannot be separated unambiguously from infrastructure/current mooring in RGB+B08; unknown.
Western elongated hull has centroid outside zone but its tip touches the boundary; avoid training that visible fragment as negative.

observations.summary: Native RGB references proposed only inside explicit quality-supported area; all unresolved and hidden signals remain unknown. Independent adjudication required.

negative_recommendation.claim: Only explicit reviewed area may support negative supervision. Tiny sub-resolution craft completeness is not established.
